planning_steps.step_description: Review available structural information and have a competent designer identify the load path and permitted removal sequence before removing members.
planning_steps.purpose: Plan removal around the structure's load path and an identified sequence.

planning_steps.step_description: Inspect for connections, services, unstable cladding, and retained components, then mark retained items and work-zone boundaries.
Install specified temporary restraint before removal when the sequence could reduce stability, and retain it until the designer's release condition is met.
Confirm the sequence, lifting arrangements, exclusion zones, and emergency communication method at the pre-start briefing.

retrieval_items.question_text: What must be established before a structural member is removed?
retrieval_items.expected_answer: Available structural information should be reviewed, and a competent designer should identify the load path and permitted removal sequence.

retrieval_items.question_text: When should temporary restraint be installed and when can it be removed?
retrieval_items.expected_answer: Install the specified temporary restraint before removal where the sequence could reduce stability, and keep it in place until the designer's release condition is met.

retrieval_items.question_text: How does the page address falling materials during overhead work?
retrieval_items.expected_answer: Remove loose items where practicable, establish an exclusion zone below overhead work, and lower components by a controlled method rather than dropping them.

source_document.page_title: Planning Selective Demolition in a Steel-Framed Warehouse
source_document.page_text: Planning Selective Demolition in a Steel-Framed Warehouse. Structural review: Before removing any member, review available structural information and have a competent designer identify the load path and the permitted removal sequence. Survey and mark: Inspect the work area for connections, services, unstable cladding, and retained components; mark items to remain and the boundaries of each work zone. Temporary stability: Where the sequence could reduce stability, install the specified temporary restraint before removal and keep it in place until the designer's release condition is met. Falling materials: Remove loose items from the work area where practicable, establish an exclusion zone below overhead work, and use a controlled method to lower components rather than dropping them. Readiness: Confirm the sequence, lifting arrangements, exclusion zones, and emergency communication method at the pre-start briefing.

document_summary: The page sets out preparation for selective warehouse demolition, emphasizing structural review, identification of retained items and services, temporary restraint, falling-material controls, and a pre-start briefing.

risk_control_items.hazard: Loss of structural stability during selective removal
risk_control_items.risk_question: Could the proposed removal sequence reduce structural stability, and what must be in place before removal?
control_measures: Have a competent designer identify the load path and permitted removal sequence.
Install the specified temporary restraint before removal where the sequence could reduce stability.
Keep the restraint in place until the designer's release condition is met.

risk_control_items.hazard: Falling components or loose material during overhead work
risk_control_items.risk_question: Could loose items or components fall into an area where people may be exposed?
control_measures: Remove loose items from the work area where practicable.
Establish an exclusion zone below overhead work.
Use a controlled method to lower components rather than dropping them.

risk_control_items.hazard: Removal or damage of components intended to remain
risk_control_items.risk_question: Have retained components and work-zone boundaries been identified before selective demolition?
control_measures: Inspect the work area for retained components.
Mark items to remain and the boundaries of each work zone.
